origin_and_wire.native: Private token tables retain actual origin snapshots and immutable full observations; inspect via current genuine native Whole inspector, not old brand minting. Exact source mappings: asset=view.asset; origin_tuple=view.tuple; digests=view.digests; ir_digest=view.verification.ir_digest.digest. Genuine whole admission requires verification.mode=whole_asset, semantic_status=verified_whole_graph, routing_integrity=checked, unchecked_sections=[], and whole_container_digest/whole_content_digest/runtime_entry_digest/ir_digest status=verified. Original A/C/E verification digests equal corresponding view.digests.*.observed. Absent complete proof is unsupported, never promoted by a data-view assertion. Preserve all original comparison evidence and profiles. Never read nonexistent view.ir_digest, recompute selected/full IR to substitute its provenance, or rewrite origin request/capture/signature/checksum receipts.
origin_and_wire.portable_wire: Serialized source contains stable asset,origin_tuple,A/C/E evidence,ir_digest, not random snapshot/capture/request IDs. Those identities remain attached privately to the real local admissions. A receiver with actual same source bytes uses its own actual native whole admission, then independently readmits Plan/Capsule/Request. JSON equality never creates a witness and no wire origin claim supplies authority.
origin_and_wire.same_context: Each native token belongs to this module/Core instance and records actual snapshot(s). Lookup must recheck genuine provenance. Capsule admission reconstructs selection from its provided genuine snapshot and compares complete source+selected context against admitted Plan context; mismatching actual values refuse, even if selected subset appears equal. Request must hold its exact admitted Plan/Capsule pair; substituted equal-looking tokens are not interchangeable.
origin_and_wire.lifetime: Follow original weak-map lifecycle: immutable Plan/Capsule may be reused, inspectors return their immutable wire or null for untrusted token; no new one-use Plan/TTL or artificial timeout. Host request/run replay is separately reserved on consume. Do not retain extra source-path handles, authority callbacks or credentials. No new public disposal/session API.
origin_and_wire.digest_domains: Compute complete wire/closure/output binding digests exactly; this does not compute fresh asset A/C/E/IR, signature or checksum verification. Same-source re-admission may have different capture IDs without changing stable wire. This adds no authenticated receipt claim.

selection_and_projection.closure: Union exact original admitted mandatory_closures.node_ids for normalized requested judgments. Validate each resolves, no missing IDs. Filter actual original ir.nodes once by union set to retain original registry order, no concatenation duplicates or count-only check. Original validated fixed-point already includes applicable global/scoped foundations,boundaries,conditions,requireddependencies,incoming edges and required relationship context. No metadata claim can add proof.
selection_and_projection.projection: Call exact original selected-context semantics on the complete ordered union. Only asset_declaration reading_order is removed and kernel.foundation_refs filtered by exact supplied target identity, with same own-property/absence and qualified-local rules; all other node values remain exact. Catalog includes supplied judgments and participants of supplied relationship nodes in original order, with full metadata-only peer question/omission. References preserve original order with both endpoints supplied; relationships preserve original values/order identified by supplied relationship nodes. Exact original ordered omissions retained, no permission/size filtering.
selection_and_projection.static_semantics: Conditions,exceptions,relationships,mechanisms,Plan/Policy declarations and authored results stay static content. Do not emit matched/evaluated/executed or choose branch/perform method. Optional one-hop Read context is not automatically appended to Capsule; only mandatory union is supplied. Existing optional reference edges with both endpoints supplied remain in references without reinterpretation.
selection_and_projection.external: Before any Plan/Capsule success, check all actual original closure targets against ir.unresolved_external.mandatory per original sourceSelection. Matching required external=>EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED_EXTERNAL/body null0. Unrelated/optional external refs do not broaden refusal. No fetch,merge,placeholder or hidden newread.

Do not compare provenance display duplicates as if Capsule fields. admission.strict_order: Preserve original strict JSON -> closed wire schema -> exact tuple/branch-definition -> actual source/selection/full binding -> actual budget. Construction options copy strict own data and exact allowed keys before selection; malformed input never reaches Host. Text/byte JSON parsing retains its original 8 MiB UTF8 input bound. Object copy/canonicalization separately retains its original 256 MiB graph accounting; object-path success above 8 MiB does not establish text/byte parser acceptance. Both retain original depth64/string1MiB/canonicalarray10000/Unicode/own-data/cycle rules. Ordinary JSON numbers need only be finite under original parse/copy/canonicalization; safe-integer/nonnegative checks apply to UInt fields at their original schema/semantic positions, not to arbitrary authored numeric values. No threshold adjustment or new general-number restriction.
admission.plan: Options exactly plan_id,intent,selection,budget. intent.reasoning_support/task are caller request text, not asset instruction or permission. Plan source copies asset=view.asset,origin_tuple=view.tuple,digests=view.digests,ir_digest=view.verification.ir_digest.digest under the complete genuine-whole proof gate above. closure_digest hashes complete projected union, not raw/unprojected/full IR. create passes same admission checks; wire readmission must match all independent source/closure/definition bindings.
admission.capsule: kind remains static_judgment_supply. Whole object reconstructed including catalog,relationships,references,omissions; exact comparison refuses changedbody/absence/order/extra/omission. P is detached SHA256JCS of complete new capsule using original profile0.2 algorithm with no omitted fields. Capsule carries no P self-field. Full canonicalUTF8 length<=plan.budget.capsule_bytes; no truncation.
admission.request: Exact host/epoch/request/run/options. Request includes complete Plan/Capsule digests and operation consume_judgment; both token instances genuinely admitted and capsule bound to exact Plan token. No Read callback or retained token can stand in for these admissions.
admission.validation: All parse/schema/digest and receipt/trace/response validation returns claims_not_authenticated. Full response validation verifies actual output UTF8digest/byte count, complete body budget, exact receipt+trace correlation. Token inspectors do not authorize anything.
